_comment: Feedback requests (V, 2026-10-04): a short question shown at random to a player, answered for a small POC reward through the reward box (nothing is minted before the player claims it). Kinds: rating (1 to 5), choice (one of `options`), text (free answer, 500 characters). `topic` ties the answers to the part of the game they judge, `tunes` says where the numbers live, for V.

questions.text: How do you find the strength of runes and rune sets?
How is the supply of grinds and gems?
How fair do the summon rates feel?
How is the speed of battles?
How is the difficulty of the campaign? (1 too hard, 3 right, 5 too easy)
How much fun is the arena?
Does energy limit you too much?
Do you earn enough Mana for what you want to do?
What is the one thing you miss most in the game?
How easy was it to start playing?
How does the game run on your device?
